input.rationale: IBM's only performance warranty (§5.1(a)) is a care-and-skill standard with no conformance warranty for the software portions of the Base Components, no warranty duration, and no stated remedy; §5.2 makes the §5.1 warranties exclusive and §5.4 disclaims error-free operation, capacity/performance and puts all Materials and non-IBM software "AS IS". The bargain therefore fails every fallback element (90-day software conformance, 30-day Services warranty, repair/replacement, refund) and approaches the walk-away position. We inserted the shortest fallback warranty inside §5.1 itself so the §5.2 exclusivity clause preserves rather than swallows it; we did not disturb §5.4's narrow disclaimers, which remain compatible with a material-conformance standard.

proposal.summary: Add conformance warranty periods (90 days software / 30 days Services) with repair, replacement and refund remedies into IBM's Section 5.1 warranty set.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5.1 gives only a care-and-skill warranty with no conformance standard, no duration and no remedy, and Sections 5.2/5.4 disclaim everything else, so we added our fallback warranty: 90 days for the software portions of the Base Components against their documentation and 30 days for the Services, with repair, replacement or re-performance and a refund as the remedy. We placed it in Section 5.1 so the exclusivity clause preserves it.

ops.text: for ninety (90) days following delivery, the software portions of the Base Components will conform in all material respects to their documentation, and for thirty (30) days following performance, the Services will conform to the applicable Service Option Attachments. Customer's remedy for breach of this warranty is repair, replacement or re-performance of the non-conforming Base Component or Services, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Base Component or Services.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
